h: Qatar sets conditions for foreign newborns to get a free visa on arrival
p: Qatar has announced the conditions under which foreign newborn babies can receive a free visa on arrival at its airports. The announcement is part of wider reporting on the visas available to foreigners landing in the country, including free transit visas for two groups of travellers.
more: Reports differ on whether there are four or five conditions.
Qatar also lists nine visa types available on arrival.
